doc: A CANDIDATE Level A template (lane H experiment, data only): the built-in `standard-decoder` plus conventions a checkpoint's tensor names reveal. (1) The MLP is gated exactly when the checkpoint has `mlp.gate_proj` (Arcee's is not). (2) Bias switches under other names (`use_bias`, `attention_out_bias`) and bookkeeping keys of new families are inert: the biases are read from the `.bias` tensors the template already looks for. It cannot learn what is class code (the rope pairing, a norm after the rotation, a router's scoring): those stay adapters.
